text_block_list.text:
On this day, Gran Alegria ran in a mock 
race. Her opponents were newly debuted 
Umamusume from her own generation.

The distance is naturally 1600m. It's 
practical-style training with an eye 
toward the Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what kind of tactics should we go 
with?

Tactics, huh... To be frank, I don't think 
we need any special plan. If it's her, she 
should be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have anything specific, do 
you mind if I just run based on my own 
feel?
choice_data_list: Ah... Yeah. Let's go with that.
Yeah... you're right. Let's go with that.

text_block_list.text:
Leaving everything to her to re-evaluate 
her running characteristics will also 
serve as a good reference for the future.
When the time came, the mock race began.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Mmm.
choice_data_list:
Jumping right before the race... that's 
unusual...

text_block_list.text:
The gates open. And at that exact moment, 
Gran Alegria makes a light hop!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Oh no, I botched the start! ...Urrgh, I'm 
dead last."

Gran Alegria settles in at the back of the 
pack. However, once the frontrunner breaks 
away and the pace settles down—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
At this pace, I can take the lead! 
—Yaaaaah!
choice_data_list: ! Gran...!?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, whoa, whoa, whoa! You gotta be 
kidding! How many girls is she passing 
from dead last?!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Such composure at that speed... And on top 
of that, she caught up and settled into 
second place. How calm and collected.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miler!

On the final straight, Gran Alegria 
accelerates once more.

Steadily pulling away from the other 
Umamusume... she crossed the finish line 
over three lengths ahead.
choice_data_list: (Gran...! What an incredible run!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I won!
choice_data_list:
Are you okay?! Any pain or weird 
discomfort?!

Are you okay!? Do you feel any pain or 
discomfort!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Not at all! I'm feeling 100 miles 
full of energy!
choice_data_list: I see... that's a relief...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, could it be because of the late start?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I was feeling restless for about 0.8 miles 
in the gate. I tried to jump to reset 
myself, and it just slipped out by 
accident.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I panicked for 0.5 miles. But I'm so glad 
I managed to recover!

A recovery... No, she simply overpowered 
it with sheer leg strength.

Her abilities are so overwhelmingly high 
that she can win through sheer brute force 
alone.

However, relying on sheer brute force... 
in other words, is recklessness.

That wasn't the kind of run one should put 
on in a mock race, outside the real event.
choice_data_list:
(I should have been the one to stop 
it...!)
(I should have stopped them...!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have anything specific, do 
you mind if I just run based on my own 
feel?

I had to instruct her to run in a way that 
kept her overwhelming power under control.

“Just because I didn't understand her 
‘instincts.’ Just because I thought she 
could win, I left it all to her...!”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Overtaking them all at once felt 70 
miles of refreshing!
choice_data_list:
(I can't guide them while I'm still in the 
dark myself.)

text_block_list.text: Time is of the essence.

I need to provide proper guidance tailored 
to Gran Alegria's extraordinary, 
out-of-the-box talent—!

—That day, at a corner table in the 
cafeteria. I confronted "him."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I took a look at the materials you sent 
over.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was talented, but... Gran 
Alegria is an extraordinary prodigy.
choice_data_list:
She will undoubtedly become the true Queen 
of the Mile.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: A genius of pure intuition, huh...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No, I can understand why you're 
struggling. Intuitive runners have such 
unique sensibilities that it's difficult 
to grasp.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I've got no choice but to take the time to 
face it and understand it.
choice_data_list:
If only I had the knowledge and 
experience, at the very least...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...This is about the mock race from the 
other day, right?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Gran has immense confidence and passion 
for the mile. Because of that, she tends 
to brute-force unexpected situations.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
At what point does it become reckless? How 
can I guide her to grow her strength 
without pushing her too far?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I know that from experience, and I can 
handle it. ...Indeed.
choice_data_list:
The way I am now, I'm lacking in every 
single way...!
As I am now, I'm lacking in everything...!

text_block_list.text:
I can't keep up with Gran Alegria's 
growth.

I'm not even sure if I can put together a 
training plan worthy of her extraordinary 
abilities.

"At this rate... the great feats and 
records she was supposed to achieve 
will..."
I might end up ruining everything...!
choice_data_list: I don't want to ruin Gran's future!

text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm here right now. To do the 
absolute best that I can—!"
choice_data_list: Please, let me learn under you!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If you go beyond seeking advice to asking 
to become their pupil, people might start 
questioning your coaching ability.
choice_data_list: Gran's future is more important!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Without a second's hesitation, huh... 
Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Alright. Since you're that determined.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Come to me, together with Gran.
choice_data_list: Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should get some sweets. Or 
would coffee be better?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... I wonder if Trainer takes sugar 
and milk?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, what a marvelous kaleidoscope 
of expressions, Gran-san. Did something 
happen?

Her name is Satono Diamond. The insatiably 
curious young lady of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dia-san! Was I making funny faces? 
Ugh, how embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You seemed to be hesitating about 
something, though...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering what kind of refreshment 
to bring for Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You've been working late every day. 
Lately, you seem about three miles tired.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for work... something sweet might 
be best, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They say having some sugar helps get your 
brain working. How about something you can 
eat while working?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That might be good♪ Yep, I'll go with 
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's from Trainer. Let's see, what 
does it say...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! What do you mean, 
apprenticeship?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, we get to be coached 
by them! I don't know how this happened, 
but I'm lucky beyond belief~~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was 0.4 miles of pure 
exhaustion!

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
G-Gran... To keep up that pace... I was 
sure... you'd gas out along the way...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you swim smoothly like a *swoosh* 
without making too many waves, you won't 
get tired as easily!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, Gran's swimming had zero wasted 
movement. She really just intuitively 
understands how to move her body, doesn't 
she?"

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm really curious about your training 
menu, Gran. Wanna warm up together 
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! In that case, the day after 
tomorrow, please teach us your warm-up 
routine, upperclassmen!

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's do that♪
choice_data_list:
(Looks like you two are getting along 
well, that's great!)

text_block_list.text:
"A few days into learning under my mentor. 
His trainees and Gran Alegria adapted to 
the sudden changes without batting an 
eye."

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry. She said she's going 
to run hill repeats today...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see, did she grasp a clue or something? 
I'll go take a look myself in a little 
while.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Are you taking the day off?

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
! ...Is it that obvious? I still haven't 
shaken off the fatigue.
choice_data_list:
(Incredible, she can tell how I'm feeling 
just by looking at me.)

text_block_list.text:
Watching the coaching up close like this, 
I'm reminded once again of how much there 
is to learn.

"My mentor engages with each and every one 
of his trainees with utmost dedication."

They are particularly attentive to the 
Umamusume's mental state. Adapting 
flexibly to her condition, without being 
bound by manuals or standard formulas.

At its core lies 'Umamusume First.' I 
could deeply feel that conviction.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...That last mile didn't feel quite 
right. I'm going to redo it one more 
time!"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe Gran should do more training 
with other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
When left alone, she overdoes it. Being 
eager is fine and all, but still.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Why not ask an Umamusume who's been 
running in the Twinkle Series for a long 
time to be your training partner?"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Opponents of that caliber should be just 
right for Gran. Her distance aptitude 
doesn't have to be limited to miles.
choice_data_list: I see... I'll try looking for it!

text_block_list.text:
I'll do everything in my power. Just like 
my mentor. Even without knowledge or 
experience, that's something I can do!
choice_data_list: I'll find the perfect match for her!
Let's find the perfect match for her!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the spirit. You understand, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Taaah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Phew... 150 miles of pure fun♪

On this day, we were doing tandem 
training. Our partners were seasoned, 
battle-hardened Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-senpai, Kris S-senpai, thank you so 
much for the tandem training!

Point man Bubble Gum Fellow, and the 
reticent professional Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure was all mine, that was really 
thrilling. So, did you get anything out of 
it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, pacing and timing your moves really 
make such a massive difference.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A difference in distance aptitude... No, 
is it a difference in our respective 
weapons? I need to optimize myself as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You figured all that out just from 
seeing me run once?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Gran's—racing sense is outstanding—truly 
exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Alright, next up is Taiki-senpai 
and Rob Roy-senpai!

There's Taiki Shuttle, and... the other 
one is Zenno Rob Roy, a bookworm girl who 
dreams of heroes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Gran, show me how much you've 
grown!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Burgers with everyone♪ Alrighty, 
good work today, everybody!
choice_data_list:
Going out to play at this hour... ah, to 
be young.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's way too early for you to act 
like an old geezer. If anything, wouldn't 
you call that youth?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Splendid. Training is important, but you 
should certainly have plenty of fun with 
your friends as well."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this salad is 5 miles delicious!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just eat salad. Eat some meat, 
meat!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
For body building— protein is—most 
important.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'll give one slice of my meat... to 
Grand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, please have mine too.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My patty has joined the mix too! Great! 
It's gotten super big!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"This is a bit... my jaw might drop off. 
It's gonna take 15 miles of courage!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Just crush it lightly and no problem!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Did the Trainer ask all of you to run 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Their running styles and distance 
aptitudes are all over the place, so what 
kind of advice did you give them?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
In my case, it was as... a simulated rival 
for actual racing, right? I imagine they 
were counting on varied race developments.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Medium distance... How to run in medium 
distance races, you say?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer gave me an extremely passionate 
presentation document...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Out of all the students, we were told that 
we are the only suitable partners for 
Gran-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...And his justification was that it was 
written in the presentation materials, 
so..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Those documents were crazy thick, huh! I 
thought it was a thesis!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! It was packed with so many, many 
feelings for Gran!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It was logical—and scientific. To be sure, 
I am the optimal choice for the role.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is that what happened...? ...Comparing all 
the students...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: To go that far for my sake...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You truly are a dedicated Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly... urgh!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Infinite miles sound wonderful, 
don't they?♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Good-mornin-mile~!
choice_data_list:
Good morn-mile! ...You seem in a great 
mood today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You know, I'm just so happy to know 
that my personal rules weren't wrong after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If it's us, we can definitely, absolutely, 
100% conquer all three divisions!!
